data_rehearsal.selection: lowest sha256(document_order_seed, domain, text_sha256); phase 3 excludes phase 1; evaluation is drawn only from frozen C3

canary_model.purpose: exercise orchestration only; losses and timings cannot rank tokenizers

required_assertions: all 48 matrix cells complete phase 1, phase 3, and evaluation
every arm sees identical ordered raw document hashes within each phase
every tokenizer artifact hash and runtime row count matches the frozen arm manifest
whole-input round trip succeeds and UNK is absent for every rehearsal document
fixed-trunk shared trunk tensors are byte-identical across arms for a paired seed
attention initialization is byte-identical across arms within each control and paired seed
phase-3 attention reinitialization is byte-identical across arms for a paired seed
production nominal and phase-specific trainable counts match actual TinyModel modules
no phase-1 quality value eliminates a matrix cell
every accounting record includes raw bytes, documents, tokens, predicted tokens, steps, estimated FLOPs, wall time, and memory
